cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(CrashReporterTest)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 26)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Find Dependencies
find_package(Vulkan REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

# Include directories
include_directories(
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${Vulkan_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)

# Define sources
set(TEST_SOURCES
    src/error_handling/test_crash_reporter.cpp
    src/error_handling/crash_reporter.cpp
    src/error_handling/error_utils.cpp
)

# Create test executable
add_executable(test_crash_reporter ${TEST_SOURCES})

# Link libraries
target_link_libraries(test_crash_reporter 
    Threads::Threads
    ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS}
)

# Platform-specific linking
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(test_crash_reporter dbghelp)
endif()
